data.name: Zander
data.gender_notes: Zander is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Zander is a Greek name derived from the Greek god Zeus. In Greek mythology, Zeus was the king of the gods and the god of the sky and thunder. Zander is a strong and powerful name, suitable for a baby boy. The name Zander carries the meaning “Man of Zeus” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Zander usually hope their child will grow to embody man of zeus and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes strength, power, and divine protection.
data.etymology: Zander belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Man of Zeus.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Zander total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_hebrew.name: זנדר
in_hebrew.meaning: זנדר הוא שומר השמים ומגן האל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: זנדר הוא שם שמקורו בשפה היוונית ונגזר מהשם אלכסנדרוס (Αλέξανδρος), שפירושו 'מגן האל' או 'שומר השמים'. השם אלכסנדרוס מורכב מהמילים 'אלכס' (להגן) ו'אנדר' (איש, גבר). השם זנדר משמש ככינוי לנוצרים שמבקשים להעניק לילדיהם שם שיהיה משמעותי ובעל ערך רוחני.

in_greek.name: Ζάντερ
in_greek.meaning: Ζάντερ σημαίνει ο υπερασπιστής του Θεού
in_greek.long_meaning: Ζάντερ είναι η ελληνική μορφή του ονόματος Αλέξανδρος (Alexandros), που σημαίνει 'ο υπερασπιστής του Θεού' ή 'ο προστάτης του Θεού'. Το όνομα αυτό προέρχεται από τις λέξεις 'αλέξ' (να προστατεύω) και 'ανδρός' (άντρας, άνθρωπος). Στην παράδοση της Εκκλησίας, το όνομα Ζάντερ έχει συνδεθεί με την προστασία και τη δύναμη που προσφέρει ο Θεός.

in_latin.name: Zander
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Zander derivatur ex nomine Alexandros, quod significat 'defensor Dei' vel 'protector Dei'. Hoc nomen constat ex vocibus 'alex' (defendere) et 'andros' (vir, homo). In traditione christiana, nomen Zander habetur ut signum protectionis et fortitudinis quam Deus praebet.

in_english.name: Zander
in_english.meaning: Defender of the people, protector of God
in_english.long_meaning: The name Zander is derived from the Greek name Alexandros (Αλέξανδρος), meaning 'defender of the people' or 'protector of God'. It is composed of the words 'alexein' (to defend) and 'andros' (man). In Christian tradition, Zander symbolizes spiritual protection and strength. Historically, the name has been associated with Saint Alexander, a 3rd-century bishop of Jerusalem. Today, Zander remains a popular name among Christians, signifying courage, faith, and divine protection.

data.cultural_impact: The name Zander holds a rich cultural heritage, originating from the ancient Greek civilization. Naming a child Zander connects them to the mythological roots of Zeus, the revered deity of the ancient Greeks, and offers a sense of strength, power, and nobility.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Zander carries the energy and qualities of Zeus, the gods of sky and thunder. It implies that the bearer of this name is divine, empowered, and strong, with a connection to the cosmic energies and the natural world. It's a reminder of the god within, encouraging personal growth, self-realization, and self-mastery.

In a Christian context, it can symbolize a strong believer, a protector or defender of faith, or someone who stands firm in their beliefs.
